title: New cell cycle checkpoint pathways regulators with 2-Oxo-indoline scaffold as potential anticancer agents: Design, synthesis, biological activities and in silico studies.
authors: Abd El-Wahab, Hend A A; Mansour, Hany S; Ali, Ahmed M; El-Awady, Raafat; Aboul-Fadl, Tarek
one_liner_zh: 该文为抗癌小分子设计与合成研究，仅涉及CDK2蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: 3-Arylidene-2-oxo-indoline derivatives are at the heart of a wide range of clinically, medicinally and biologically important compounds among the 2-oxo-indolines. A number of 3-arylidene-2-oxo-indolines have been approved for clinical application. Accordingly, the current work describes the structural based design of 3-arylidene-2-oxindole derivatives through docking of their structures in the active site of CDK2 as one of the dominant enzyme checkpoints. Based on the docking studies a range of 3-arylidene-2-oxindole derivatives, 5(a-n) and 6(a-x), with variable substituents at positions 1 and 5 of the 2-oxindole as well as 3 and 4 of the aryl moieties were synthesized. These molecules exist in either E or Z diastereomer about the exocyclic double bond at position 3 of oxindole nucleus. Their structures were confirmed by spectral and elemental methods of analyses and the E/Z-configuration of the diastereomers was confirmed by 2D NOE analysis. In vitro cytotoxicity of these molecules was tested against four cancerous cell lines, namely, breast cancer cell line (MCF7), liver carcinoma cell line (HepG2), cervix carcinoma cell line (HeLa), colon cancer cell line (HCT116) in addition to the diploid human normal non-cancerous cell line (F180) using SRB and MTT assays. The tested molecules showed variable cytotoxic effects on the four cancer cell lines with pronounced selectivity compared to the normal one (F180) with no significant difference between E and Z diastereomers. Compounds 5a, 5b, 5e(1), 5m, 6f and 6j were tested for the effect on the expression on CDK2, p53, caspase-3 and caspase-9 proteins, and revealed variable activities compared to the positive controls Sunitinib and Staurosporine. These molecules seem to have multiple cellular targets as they induced expression of p53 and caspases while inhibited that of CDK2. Apoptotic effect of compound 6j was further investigated using annexin V-FITC/PI dual staining assay and showed that cells treated with 6j have nearly 15 folds greater apoptotic effect than that of the control cells. Furthermore, inhibitory activity of compounds 5a, 5b, 5e(1), 5m, 6f and 6j on CDK2 enzyme were tested and revealed that compound 6f, with the N-4-flourobenzyl- 2-oxindole and 3-p-chlorobenzylidene moieties, has a comparable inhibitory activity to the reference drug sunitinib.
abstract_zh: 3-亚芳基-2-氧代吲哚啉衍生物是2-氧代吲哚啉类化合物中一系列具有临床、药用和生物学重要性的核心化合物。多种3-亚芳基-2-氧代吲哚啉已被批准用于临床应用。因此，本研究通过将其结构对接至CDK2活性位点（作为主要酶检查点之一），描述了基于结构的3-亚芳基-2-氧代吲哚衍生物设计。基于对接研究，合成了一系列在2-氧代吲哚的1位和5位以及芳基部分的3位和4位具有不同取代基的3-亚芳基-2-氧代吲哚衍生物5(a-n)和6(a-x)。这些分子在吲哚酮核3位的外环双键上以E或Z非对映异构体形式存在。其结构通过光谱和元素分析方法确认，非对映异构体的E/Z构型通过2D NOE分析验证。使用SRB和MTT法测试了这些分子对四种癌细胞系（即乳腺癌细胞系(MCF7)、肝癌细胞系(HepG2)、宫颈癌细胞系(HeLa)、结肠癌细胞系(HCT116）以及二倍体人正常非癌细胞系(F180）的体外细胞毒性。测试分子对四种癌细胞系表现出不同的细胞毒性效应，与正常细胞系(F180）相比具有显著选择性，且E和Z非对映异构体之间无显著差异。测试了化合物5a、5b、5e(1)、5m、6f和6j对CDK2、p53、caspase-3和caspase-9蛋白表达的影响，结果显示与阳性对照Sunitinib和Staurosporine相比具有不同活性。这些分子似乎具有多个细胞靶点，因为它们诱导p53和caspases的表达，同时抑制CDK2的表达。进一步使用annexin V-FITC/PI双染色法研究了化合物6j的凋亡效应，结果显示用6j处理的细胞其凋亡效应约为对照细胞的近15倍。此外，测试了化合物5a、5b、5e(1)、5m、6f和6j对CDK2酶的抑制活性，结果显示含有N-4-氟苄基-2-氧代吲哚和3-对氯苄叉基部分的化合物6f具有与参考药物sunitinib相当的抑制活性。
